Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/profile/service/UserProfileService.java only.
- Import existing entities/repos: UserProfile, UserProfileRepository, SecurityAuditLog, SecurityAuditLogRepository.
- Methods:
  * getProfile(Long userId): returns UserProfile or creates default profile if not exists.
  * updateProfile(Long userId, String displayName, String avatarUrl, String measurementUnit, String themeMode, Boolean familySharing, Boolean telemetry): updates non-null fields, saves and returns UserProfile.
  * logSecurityAction(Long userId, String actionType, String ipAddress, String deviceInfo, String status): saves SecurityAuditLog.
  * getAuditLogs(Long userId): returns List<SecurityAuditLog>.
